title: Flashcards: Reptiles, families
intro: Flip each card about reptiles. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: To which family does the Black-headed Python (Aspidites melanocephalus) belong?
cards.explain: The Black-headed Python belongs to the family python.

cards.front: To which family does the Angonoka tortoise (Astrochelys yniphora) belong?
cards.explain: The Angonoka tortoise belongs to the family Testudinidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Gaboon Adder (Bitis gabonica) belong?
cards.explain: The Gaboon Adder belongs to the family viper.

cards.front: To which family does the Banded krait (Bungarus fasciatus) belong?
cards.explain: The Banded krait belongs to the family Elapidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Common Caiman (Caiman crocodilus) belong?
cards.explain: The Common Caiman belongs to the family alligators and caimans.

cards.front: To which family does the Crocodylus novaeguinae (Crocodylus novaeguineae) belong?
cards.explain: The Crocodylus novaeguinae belongs to the family Crocodile.

cards.front: To which family does the Burmese star tortoise (Geochelone platynota) belong?
cards.explain: The Burmese star tortoise belongs to the family Testudinidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Agassiz's desert tortoise (Gopherus agassizii) belong?
cards.explain: The Agassiz's desert tortoise belongs to the family Testudinidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Gila monster (Heloderma suspectum) belong?
cards.explain: The Gila monster belongs to the family Helodermatidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus) belong?
cards.explain: The Mediterranean house gecko belongs to the family gecko.

cards.front: To which family does the Lesser Antillean Green Iguana (Iguana delicatissima) belong?
cards.explain: The Lesser Antillean Green Iguana belongs to the family Iguanidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Elongated tortoise (Indotestudo elongata) belong?
cards.explain: The Elongated tortoise belongs to the family Testudinidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Banded sea krait (Laticauda colubrina) belong?
cards.explain: The Banded sea krait belongs to the family Elapidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Ptyas mucosus (Ptyas mucosa) belong?
cards.explain: The Ptyas mucosus belongs to the family Colubridae.

cards.front: To which family does the Asiatic rock python (Python molurus) belong?
cards.explain: The Asiatic rock python belongs to the family python.

cards.front: To which family does the common box turtle (Terrapene carolina) belong?
cards.explain: The common box turtle belongs to the family Emydidae.
